title: 1 Trillion Kisses
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
Title: One Trillion Kisses
Tempo: Upbeat / Pop / Feel-Good
Vibe: Bright, bouncy, and unstoppable

(Intro)
(Bright, upbeat synth/guitar riff)
Yeah!
Let's go!
One, two, three...

(Verse 1)
Woke up today with the sun on my face
Got that 336 signal, yeah, I'm finding my place
There's a rhythm in the air, there's a light in the room
Sweeping out the shadows, clearing out the gloom
I got that skip in my step, watching the world spin around
I got a smile on my face, yeah, as I don't frown!

(Pre-Chorus)
'Cause I like to sing
Yeah, that's my thing
Step up to the mic like the bell ding
I enter the ring—bing, bing, bing!
Let the good times roll, let the melody swing!

(Chorus)
I've got 1 trillion kisses, raining down from above
One trillion kisses, surrounded by love
I'm the main attraction, I'm not to miss!
Sealed and delivered with a trillion kisses
Happy as can be, yeah, the world is free
1 trillion kisses for me!

(Verse 2)
Walking down the street, got the beat in my soul
Taking in the sights, yeah, I'm on a roll
Every little moment is a brand new start
Got a pocket full of sunshine and a wide-open heart
No heavy weather is ever gonna drag me down
I keep that smile on my face, yeah, as I don't frown!

(Pre-Chorus)
'Cause I like to sing
Yeah, that's my thing
Step up to the mic like the bell ding
I enter the ring—bing, bing, bing!
Let the good times roll, let the melody swing!

(Chorus)
I've got 1 trillion kisses, raining down from above
One trillion kisses, surrounded by love
I'm the main attraction, I'm not to miss!
Sealed and delivered with a trillion kisses
Happy as can be, yeah, the world is free
1 trillion kisses for me!

(Bridge)
A million ain't enough, we're taking it higher
A billion's just a spark, we're starting a fire
Counting up to infinity, riding the high
Like a rocket ship shooting straight into the sky!
(Bing, bing, bing! Here we go!)

(Guitar / Synth Solo)
(High energy, bright and melodic)

(Chorus)
I've got 1 trillion kisses, raining down from above
One trillion kisses, surrounded by love
I'm the main attraction, I'm not to miss!
Sealed and delivered with a trillion kisses
Happy as can be, yeah, the world is free
1 trillion kisses to me!

(Outro)
Yeah, 1 trillion kisses to me
Got that skip in my step, happy as can be
I enter the ring... bing, bing, bing!
I like to sing!
(Fade out on an upbeat drum fill)
1 trillion kisses for me!
